latin: Cum dixit Abucaten causam primam superiorem esse omni narratione, non tam propter id habet ueritatem quod primo affert, quia scilicet causam ante se non habet, quam propter id quod secundario innuit, quia omne intelligibile unialiter antecedit.
translation: When Abucaten said that the first cause is above all description, it has its truth not so much on account of what it first states, namely that it has no cause before itself, as on account of what it hints at secondarily, namely that it precedes every intelligible in a unitary way.
